programme.desc: Jack Frost ushers in winter every year, but he is upset that he is unable to interact with humans, since they cannot see him. When Jack arrives in town and is introduced to Elisa and her family, he learns they are oppressed by a greedy Cossack, who has eyes on the peasants' income and Elisa.
